description: Header file for LibXDiff, a C library for computing differences between files, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to diff operations.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns pointer to the first data of a memory-mapped file and its size.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns size of the memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two files.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Merges two files with optional conflict resolution.
